description: Pause a running campaign now. Emails that have not started to go out are canceled, and their leads get those steps again when it resumes. Its settings, steps and leads stay. Pausing a paused campaign changes nothing. A draft or a finished one answers 409 `campaignNotRunning`. Resume it with launch_campaign.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: pause_campaign
title: Pause a campaign
